senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Crying, calling, howling.
E.
रु to cry, शतृ aff.

m. (-वुः)
The castor-oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)
E.
रु to weep, कु aff., and the final vowel changed to उव; also with कन् added रुवुक, and with the first or second vowel made long, रुवुक and रुवूक; also, as differently derived, उरुवूक.

m. (-कः)
The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis): see रूवु; also रूवूक, and रुवुक, &c.
